ruleDefinitions.name: Enabling COR Profiler Environment Variables
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects .NET Framework CLR and .NET Core CLR "cor_enable_profiling" and "cor_profiler" variables being set and configured.

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX("\\\\COR\\_ENABLE\\_PROFILING$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\COR\\_PROFILER$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\CORECLR\\_ENABLE\\_PROFILING$")) OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\CORECLR\\_PROFILER\\_PATH.*"))
